description: On the team page: a visual analysis report from T-006 (defensive weakness grid across types, offensive coverage gaps, role balance, per-slot suggestions) and an opponent picker that switches the report to vs-opponent 'what to improve'. Plus a coach chat panel (reuse AskConsole patterns + SSE) wired to /api/teams/{id}/ask so the user can ask 'best EV/ability for X', 'how do I beat this opponent', etc., with streamed, cited answers and the assistant's honest abstentions surfaced. Show llm-disabled state gracefully when no API key.
title: Frontend: coach panel + analysis view (vs-opponent)
